findings.metric_definition: Count of torn coordinators still alive by weakref after the harness drops its references and gc.collect(), over N reload rounds
findings.phenomenon_property: No module-level WeakKeyDictionary keyed by a coordinator may hold a value that strongly references that coordinator (directly or via a bound method/closure); a torn-down coordinator must be collectable after unload

findings.title: An empty Tibber price response counts as a successful fetch and wipes the last good price list
findings.claim: An HTTP-200 Tibber response whose today and tomorrow lists are empty makes _fetch_tibber_prices replace a good 96-row _prices with 0 rows. It returns success with no UpdateFailed and clears the outage latch.
findings.mechanism: prices_from_tibber_payload returns [] (a list, not a failure reason). pull_prices treats that as 'ok', and _fetch_tibber_prices assigns it to _prices and calls _tibber_fetch_recovered. The entity path (prices_from_entity_attributes) refuses the same no-rows case.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out box shared with other seats; the count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb wraps price_model.prices_from_tibber_payload so that an empty row list returns a failure reason string

findings.metric_definition: 1 if a good 96-row fetch followed by an empty-lists 200 fetch leaves coordinator._prices at 0 rows with no UpdateFailed, else 0
findings.phenomenon_property: A price ingress path must never report success on a response that carries no usable price row. Such a response is a failed fetch, and the last good list is kept.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: prices_from_tibber_payload returns a reason string when no row survives, so pull_prices falls back to the hourly query and then to 'fail'. This matches prices_from_entity_attributes.

findings.title: Tibber rows without startsAt are admitted and then placed by position as hourly rows
findings.claim: A Tibber response of 96 quarter-hour rows that lack startsAt is admitted whole with starts_at=''. _known_prices_for then falls back to positional hourly placement, so 95 of 96 horizon steps get the price of the wrong quarter.
findings.mechanism: prices_from_tibber_payload defaults a missing start to '' instead of dropping the row; the entity path's _raw_start drops it. When no entry has a parseable timestamp, _known_prices_for repeats each entry 4 times from the first step.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out box shared with other seats; the count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb wraps prices_from_tibber_payload to drop rows whose starts_at fails datetime.fromisoformat (and to refuse a response left empty)

findings.metric_definition: Of 96 quarter steps from midnight, the number where _known_prices_for's value differs from the row whose quarter that step is, after the real fetch of a startsAt-less payload
findings.phenomenon_property: No external price row with an unparseable start reaches _prices, and no consumer places a price by position instead of by timestamp.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Make the Tibber parser drop rows without a parseable start, as the entity path does. Retire the positional fallback in _known_prices_for, or log it once.
